title: DeepSeek Releases Open-Source MoE Architecture with Multi-Head Latent Attention
summary: DeepSeek has introduced a new open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model featuring Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), significantly reducing inference memory footprint while matching dense model reasoning benchmarks.

title: Anthropic Announces Claude 3.7 Sonnet with Hybrid Reasoning Modes
summary: Anthropic reveals Claude 3.7 Sonnet offering dual-mode reasoning: near-instant standard generation alongside an adjustable deliberate thinking mode for complex code generation and mathematical analysis.

title: Speculative Decoding Reaches 3x Speedup on Consumer GPUs via Draft Verification
summary: A new speculative decoding paper demonstrates a 3x generation speedup on single consumer GPUs by utilizing tiny specialized draft models with zero perplexity degradation on 70B target models.

title: Building Production Agentic Workflows with LangGraph: A Deep Dive
summary: A comprehensive guide on managing state persistence, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and durable event checkpoints for mission-critical enterprise LLM agents.

title: OpenAI Introduces Web Search Native Integration in Operator API
summary: Developers can now trigger live autonomous web browsing, search verification, and structured data extraction through OpenAI's unified Operator API.

title: vLLM 0.7 Introduces Chunked Prefill and FlashAttention-3 Support
summary: The high-throughput LLM serving engine vLLM adds native chunked prefill, distributed multi-node pipeline parallelism, and optimized FP8 kernels for Hopper architectures.

title: Why Context Caching is Revolutionizing LLM Application Costs
summary: Prompt caching has slashed LLM token bills by 80% for large codebase queries and long-running interactive agents. Here is an analysis of cache eviction policies.

title: Self-Rewarding Language Models with Hierarchical Preference Optimization
summary: Researchers propose a novel reinforcement learning framework where models synthesize their own evaluation rubrics, outperforming human preference annotation datasets.

title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Infrastructure Stacks and Synthetic Data Pipelines
summary: Meta releases open tooling used to generate multi-modal synthetic alignment data and test high-concurrency training clusters for next-generation foundation models.

title: SQLite as a Vector Database: Benchmarks and Surprising Findings
summary: Benchmarking sqlite-vec against dedicated vector databases for datasets up to 1 million vectors. Demonstrates that for local and embedded systems, SQLite is remarkably competitive.
